mods.name: sha-links
mods.description: Commit SHAs in Claude's replies, and in the output of git commands, become links to the commit page when origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.

mods.name: issue-links
mods.description: #123 references in Claude's replies become links to that issue when the repository's origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.

mods.name: path-shorten
mods.description: Tool rows draw long absolute file paths shorter: the project root as ./ and your home folder as ~. Display only; Bash commands are drawn as they ran.
